zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: Chrome 长截图稳定性修复
changes: 侧栏切换到未授权的新标签页时，提示在当前网页重新点击插件图标
Chrome 截图或网页响应超时后结束采集；取消操作可及时恢复网页状态
Chrome 插件更新至 0.2.1，更新 App 后需重新导出并加载；仍仅支持文档滚动
应用与 DMG 已通过 Apple 公证，Sparkle 更新包带有签名

en.label: Latest
en.title: Chrome long capture reliability
changes: When the side panel moves to a new tab without access, it asks you to click the extension icon on that tab.
Capture ends when Chrome screenshots or page responses time out; Cancel can promptly restore the page.
The Chrome extension is updated to 0.2.1; export and reload it after updating the App. Only document scrolling is supported.
The App and DMG are Apple-notarized, and the Sparkle update package is signed.
